name: optics-framework
description: Drive Android, iOS, smart TV and web sessions from your agent, then save the steps as CSV/YAML test suites.
long_description:
Optics (`optics-framework` on PyPI, Apache-2.0) is open-source UI test automation for Android, iOS, Android TV, Samsung Tizen, LG webOS and web. This bundle runs its local MCP server (`optics mcp`) so an agent can open a session, read the screen as a compact element list or screenshot, tap, type and swipe, and assert on what it sees. Elements fall back from XPath to visible text to OCR to image matching.

The agent can then write what it did as a CSV or YAML suite (read the `optics://project-format` resource) that `optics execute` runs in CI.

Requirements: uv on your PATH (it installs Python 3.12+ and the package on first start, which can take a minute or two). For Android, iOS and TV, a running Appium server with the UiAutomator2 or XCUITest driver. For web, a Playwright Chromium build (`uvx --from "optics-framework[mcp,appium,playwright]==1.11.0" playwright install chromium`). The server calls no AI service and needs no account or API key.
